newsitem.title: GREECE: MAC-THRACE BANK OFFERS FOREX DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS.
newsitem.headline: MAC-THRACE BANK OFFERS FOREX DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS.

text.p: Macedonia-Thrace Bank said on Thursday it launched deposit accounts in foreign currency for permanent residents as well as corporations domiciled in Greece following the recent lifting of controls by the Bank of Greece.
Clients may open the new accounts either converting drachmas into foreign currency or directly depositing foreign currency banknotes, it said.
The minimum amount for opening a new foreign currency deposit account is the equivalent of $500 and $2,000 for time deposits, it said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
